title: [G1] Define code ownership and evidence-based pull request review
body:
Define code ownership and review requirements.

- [ ] Add CODEOWNERS and a short PR/review policy.
- [ ] Require verification evidence and review of tenant, rights, media and retry boundaries.
- [ ] Document sole-maintainer review and emergency exceptions. Track remote enforcement in O7.

title: [G2] Close dependency and secret-scan coverage gaps with a triage policy
body:
Extend security checks beyond npm audit.

- [ ] Scan locked Python dependencies, the built image and repository history for secrets.
- [ ] Pin scanner versions and retain redacted, commit-bound results.
- [ ] Test harmless detection fixtures and scanner failures; define triage owners and expiring exceptions. Keep hosted settings in O7.

title: [G3] Separate and validate staging and production configuration
body:
Separate staging and production configuration.

- [ ] Add secret-free environment examples and secure configuration validation.
- [ ] Use separate databases, storage and service identities; staging uses synthetic data.
- [ ] Test insecure defaults, shared-resource mistakes and missing settings without logging secrets. Keep decoder isolation in V1 and storage in V2.

title: [G4] Add production-mode container smoke tests for release candidates
body:
Test the production start path on the candidate image.

- [ ] Run the image with disposable database/storage and test HTTPS.
- [ ] Exercise upload, review, render, download, deletion and restart recovery.
- [ ] Verify tenancy, origin/cookie controls and disabled demo access; retain commit/image-bound evidence. Keep restore/rollback drills in O4.

title: [G5] Establish accessibility and cross-browser failure-flow QA gates
body:
Extend browser and accessibility QA.

- [ ] Test the critical workflow in Chromium and another supported engine.
- [ ] Check keyboard navigation, dialog focus, errors and status announcements against applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
- [ ] Cover interrupted uploads, session expiry, stale edits, retry and cleanup failures; link defects to tested versions.

title: [G6] Define board workflow, milestone exit criteria and release ownership
body:
Define product workflow and release gates.

- [ ] Document board states, WIP limits, owners, priorities, dependencies and acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Define local, staging and public-beta gates with evidence and decision ownership.
- [ ] Maintain an issue-based board when Projects access is unavailable; record real CI/settings and permission gaps.
